recognized_approval: explicit Steward instruction naming the lane

views.meaning: Golden Websites, property economics, scorecard pointers
contributor classes, 15% envelope, property deals, not issued equity
display-policy flags, sensitive-system labels, least-privilege reminders, compliance risk flags. Not application authorization.
planned / in-progress / completed as declared metadata only

layers.meaning: nodes allowed for the selected view
nodes flagged contributor_relevant for a stated scope_id; not identity login
declared relationship edges; not proven runtime coupling
nodes with revenue_visible; amounts stay UNKNOWN unless sourced

rules: audience and layer fields control visual disclosure only
hiding a node does not make it inaccessible in any authorized security system
public_safe nodes may later feed GW-5-class doorways only through a sanitizer, never by pointing the public map at the private graph
contributor_scoped requires a later identity contract; Z-VUE-0 stores the field only
operator and steward nodes stay off public Golden Website maps
forbidden_to_map must not appear in any generated graph instance

graph_integrity.node_id: stable string; unique within one graph instance
graph_integrity.edge_identity: edge_id unique when present; otherwise composite from+to+relationship_kind should be unique within one instance
graph_integrity.direction: from is source, to is target; edges are directed
graph_integrity.json_schema_enforcement: NOT_SCHEMA_ENFORCEABLE for uniqueness, dangling refs, or self-edges

evidence_state.rule: Do not invent traffic-light meanings for evidence_state. QUALIFIED remains QUALIFIED. SEALED != deployed.

explorer_token.rule: VIEW LAYER ONLY. explorer_token != evidence_state. explorer_token != health system of record. explorer_token is not a command, authorization, phase transition, execution instruction, deployment trigger, or mutation instruction.

golden_website_relationships.public_map: GW-5 six-node foundation remains the public doorway
golden_website_relationships.private_or_contributor_graph: Z-VUE contract may describe a wider graph later
golden_website_relationships.rule: Do not load private overlay, Twin records, or operator catalogs into universe-map.html
golden_website_relationships.property_economics: Site/module contribution uses PROPERTY_ECONOMICS or MODULE_ECONOMICS, not parent equity

partnership_links.rule: Partnership metadata on a node is not an issued agreement. GRAPH RELATIONSHIP != LEGAL RELATIONSHIP. Drawn edges do not create equity, vesting, revenue entitlement, employment, contract, payment, or ownership.

claims_requiring_provenance_when_asserte: partnership economic_lane other than NONE or UNKNOWN

unknown_property_policy.graph_schema: additionalProperties false on the document and on nested objects
unknown_property_policy.reason: v1 closed so executable, legal, or auth fields cannot appear silently
